subject: status-line-from-snapshot
kind: repair
result: pass
revision: afd60845e9ffcfcd44d028603b46bdcffadc313a
evidence: Failing-before run on unfixed code: `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_status.py -q` gave 2 failed, 8 passed. The failures were test_prints_nothing_for_an_effort_without_a_goal and test_every_line_names_a_snapshot_effort_with_matching_counts; the old script printed an extra "orphan · 1 ready" line. After the fix, the same command gave 10 passed. tests/test_dashboard_status.py plus tests/test_e2e_dashboard.py gave 11 passed. The serial tmux run `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests -q -m tmux -rf` gave 10 passed, 299 deselected. Runtime: the seeded-store test passes under its 1.0 s assert. `--durations` shows no test phase longer than 0.45 s, and the slowest test call, which also builds a snapshot in-process, takes 0.44 s. Timeout check: a fake binary that sleeps 10 s made the script exit 0 with no output after 2.055 s, run under /usr/bin/python3.
observations: The old script parsed the project:dashboard contract view. That view lists every effort that has work-items, so a goal-less effort got a line, for example "test-effort · 1 ready". The new script calls dashboard_model.load_snapshot. It prints one line per EffortView in snapshot order. Running and ready come from TaskRow.status, and needs you is len(view.needs_you). The output format is unchanged: zero counts are omitted, and a goal-only effort prints just its name. The script imports only stdlib, artifact_store and dashboard_model. The guards are: no directory, no store, or a store with no resolvable contract all print nothing. ModelError and OSError print nothing. A SIGALRM after 2 s calls os._exit(0), so it does not wait for in-flight CLI threads; load_snapshot's own per-call timeout is 30 s. I dropped the dashboard-view guard because load_snapshot does not use that view. A store that is not a se-workflow store still prints nothing, because the CLI `list --type project:*` fails and raises ModelError. I renamed test_prints_nothing_without_a_dashboard_view to test_prints_nothing_when_the_cli_fails and kept its body: a fake store with a contract that has no dashboard view now hits the CLI-failure path. The README "Status line segment" section now names the snapshot as the source, says a goal-less effort gets no line, and lists the empty-output cases (no store, CLI failure, longer than 2 s). Files changed: /home/ayin/se-workflow/scripts/dashboard-status, /home/ayin/se-workflow/tests/test_dashboard_status.py, /home/ayin/se-workflow/README.md. There is one commit; nothing is pushed.
root_cause: dashboard-status took its efforts from the project:dashboard contract view, which groups by work-item effort. The app takes its efforts from active goals in load_snapshot. The two sources disagreed for efforts that have work-items but no active goal.
